newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Concorde to raise 71 mln rand for expansion.
newsitem.headline: Concorde to raise 71 mln rand for expansion.

text.p: Concorde Travel Holdings Ltd said on Friday that, following the announcement on November 20 of Concorde's purchase of the Cullinan Hotel, it would develop further hotels in major South African centres.
It said in order to finance these developments, it would raise 71.58 million rand before expenses through a clawback offer.
In terms of the offer, Concorde would issue 71.58 million shares at an issue price of 100 cents a share in the ratio of 70 shares for every 100 Concorde shares held.
